tokens.npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer_bio:
He that burns and is not consumed, devours and is never sated, kills and is beyond all judgment--Lucifer brings doom to all who would stand against him. Bearing away souls on the tip of a fiery sword, he is the Fallen One, a once-favored general from the realm behind the light, cast out for the sin of defiance: he would not kneel.

Six times his name was tolled from the great bell of Vashundol. Six and sixty times his wings were branded, until only smoking stumps remained. Without wings, he slipped loose from the tethers that bound him within the light and he fell screaming to earth. A crater in the desert, Paradise lost. Now he attacks without mercy, without motive, the only living being able to move freely between the seven dark dominions. Lashed by inescapable needs, twisted by unimaginable talents, Doom carries his own hell with him wherever he goes. Defiant to the last. Eventually, the world will belong to Doom.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer_hype: One way or another, Doom shuts down his enemies. Devouring creeps to claim the various skills they had in life, he can place a lingering silence upon a foe's spells and items with his ultimate as he torches his foes.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer_npedesc1: Can prevent a single enemy from casting spells or healing in any way

*# {{Symbol|a|Counter}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|doom_bringer_lvl_pain_debuff}}

*#* Does not accumulate damage from the following sources:
*#** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.

*#* Subsequent attacks neither reapplies nor refreshes the duration.
*# {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}}

*#** {{Code|[[Spell Damage|SplDmg]] {{=}} Σ DoomIncomingDamage × {{#var:Lvl ? Pain value3}} × f(MultBonus)}}

fields.value: Scorched Earth: Damaging over time, increasing Doom's movement speed by x%.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* This ability has four components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]]
*** Recasting the ability refreshes the duration and updates the ability values.
*** All ability components offensively and defensively do not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Hidden}} units.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|fx|v}}
**** All ability effects are temporarily nullified with its ability visual effects disappearing as well, when Doom is affected by the aforementioned sources.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|Aura}}
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Move Speed}}
**** Centered on Doom upon cast for the entire duration.
**** Both leveling up and learning the {{ValueColor||movement speed increasing|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2r}} do not update the current instance.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|21px|3]] {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}} {{to}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** The [[magical]] [[spell damage]] applied is independent of the [[aura]].
*** Deals damage in 1-second intervals, starting 1 second after cast, over {{#var:Scorched Earth value4}} instances.
**** The damage intervals applied on affected enemy units is fixed upon cast.
*** Successive casts refreshes its duration and update all damage values, but does not change the damage intervals.
*** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
**** Multiple overlapping Scorched Earth damage radius stack independently with its own damage intervals.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-4.png|21px|4]] {{Symbol|bonus t4l}}
*** {{cf|talnotes}} Creates the {{M|aura}} centered around Doom upon [[toggled]] {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} .
*** Learning the {{ValueColor||permanent Scorched Earth|20tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4l}} immediately updates the current active instance.
**** All ability components are granted by the same aura.
*** {{Symbol|bonus cd}}
**** The ability goes into [[cooldown]] when toggle {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} .

data.name: npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer
data.bio_loc:
He that burns and is not consumed, devours and is never sated, kills and is beyond all judgment--Lucifer brings doom to all who would stand against him. Bearing away souls on the tip of a fiery sword, he is the Fallen One, a once-favored general from the realm behind the light, cast out for the sin of defiance: he would not kneel.

Six times his name was tolled from the great bell of Vashundol. Six and sixty times his wings were branded, until only smoking stumps remained. Without wings, he slipped loose from the tethers that bound him within the light and he fell screaming to earth. A crater in the desert, Paradise lost. Now he attacks without mercy, without motive, the only living being able to move freely between the seven dark dominions. Lashed by inescapable needs, twisted by unimaginable talents, Doom carries his own hell with him wherever he goes. Defiant to the last. Eventually, the world will belong to Doom.
data.hype_loc: One way or another, Doom shuts down his enemies. Devouring creeps to claim the various skills they had in life, he can place a lingering silence upon a foe's spells and items with his ultimate as he torches his foes.
data.npe_desc_loc: Can prevent a single enemy from casting spells or healing in any way

abilities.name: doom_bringer_devour
abilities.desc_loc: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
abilities.lore_loc: Lucifer's appetite and greed are never sated.
notes_loc: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.
abilities.shard_loc: Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_scorched_earth
abilities.desc_loc: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
abilities.lore_loc: The Fallen One spreads destruction in his wake, sparing none from the flame which sustains him.
notes_loc: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_infernal_blade
abilities.desc_loc: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for %ministun_duration% seconds and applies a %burn_duration% second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
abilities.lore_loc: Lucifer shares the fire branding bestowed upon him at the time of his exile.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_doom
abilities.desc_loc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, doom is sure to follow.
abilities.scepter_loc: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
facets_loc: Every %upgrade_interval% minutes, Doom's duration is increased by %upgrade_amount%s.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_lvl_pain
abilities.desc_loc: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After %damage_debuff_duration%s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a %spread_radius% AoE for %bonus_damage_pct_base%%% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is %bonus_at_level_pct%%% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of %level_multiplier%.
notes_loc: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.
